title: Oklahoma Residential Landlord and Tenant Act
source_id: Okla. Stat. tit. 41, secs. 101 et seq.
verified_how: queried the Legislature's own statute search (Title 41, SearchText 'Oklahoma Residential Landlord and Tenant Act'): 6 current sections carry the short title - 41-51, 41-101 (the short-title section), 41-111, 41-113, 41-113.2 and 41-132. 'Title 41 - Landlord and Tenant' confirmed on the titles index, currency 'last updated on November 18th, 2025'.
notes: Title 41 as a whole is Landlord and Tenant and this Act is its residential core (rent, deposits, habitability, notice, termination). General consumer protection sits elsewhere - the Oklahoma Consumer Protection Act in Title 15 (Contracts) and the Uniform Consumer Credit Code in Title 14A - not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
